0022600029.text: The Grizzlies host the Thunder in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, Memphis's 9th of the season. Memphis enters at 6-2, second in the Southwest and 0.5 games back, on a six-game winning stretch... no, on a last-ten mark of 6-2 but a two-game losing streak, while Oklahoma City is also 6-2, second in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, on a two-game winning streak and a perfect 4-0 at home. Memphis is missing Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness) and Isaiah Stewart (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (out, shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (out, knee), Jalen Williams (out, leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (out, back spasms), Nikola Topic (out, back), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Grizzlies lost 0-3 to the Thunder in 2025-26, including a 117-116 loss in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
